description: IOTC Record of Authorised Vessels and IOTC IUU Vessel List (semicolon CSV). Authored offline fixture in the provider's documented or observed export shape. Every vessel, name, IMO number (check digits valid), call sign, owner and listing here is SYNTHETIC and describes no real vessel; statistics and effort values are illustrative, NOT live evidence. Verify against the live sources before any live run (#2346).
scenarios: register bounded to flags ESP and SYC
IMO number failing its check digit flagged malformed
IUU listing of a renamed and re-flagged vessel with previous identities
